phrase.zh: 为每一种声音，留一个位置。

visual.zh: 近距离裁切的钢琴横过下方，琴键斜向展开，红棕木质边沿向右上弯起；左上小书翻起一页，音叉横放在旁边。书页空白，没有乐谱或文字。彩色版保留木色、象牙色、绿布书封与钢色；黑白版沿用相同位置和真实的两键、三键交替排列。书、钢琴和音叉为原创意象，不是罗兰真实物件或小说场景。
visual.en: A closely cropped piano crosses the lower frame, its diagonal keys beneath a reddish-brown rim rising at right. A smaller open book lifts a blank page beside a tuning fork. There is no notation or writing. Color retains wood, ivory, green cloth and steel; monochrome preserves positions and the correct alternating two/three black-key groups. Objects are original symbols, not Rolland’s possessions or a novel scene.

background.zh:
罗曼·罗兰获得1915年诺贝尔文学奖，独享奖金份额；诺贝尔官方记录他在1916年领取这个1915年度奖项。获奖理由肯定其文学中的理想、同情，以及描绘不同人物时对真实的重视。官方介绍指出，他的写作关注人对幸福、意义和真理的追求；1915年的作品介绍也记载他研究文学、音乐与哲学。书、钢琴与音叉是本作的原创解读，不引用小说、乐谱或获奖者的话。短句为原创。
1915年文学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：肯定其文学创作的崇高理想，以及描绘不同人物时展现的同情与对真实的热爱
background.en:
Romain Rolland received the 1915 Nobel Prize in Literature with the full share; Nobel’s record distinguishes that award year from receipt in 1916. The motivation recognizes idealism, sympathy and truthfulness in his portrayal of varied people. The official facts describe a search for happiness, meaning and truth; the 1915 account also records his study of literature, music and philosophy. Book, piano and tuning fork are an original interpretation, without copied prose, notation or a quotation. The phrase is original.
1915 — The Nobel Prize in Literature. Received the full prize. Official motivation: as a tribute to the lofty idealism of his literary production and to the sympathy and love of truth with which he has described different types of human beings
